steps.speaker: Linzi
steps.text_key: You carry something rare in this age. I could feel it before I saw you.

steps.speaker: Linzi
steps.text_key: I know a path through the Veiled Vale. Not many are ready for it — but you might be.

steps.speaker: Linzi
steps.text_key: I will be near the mission board if you wish to speak further. Take your time.
